title: 第5章 咒骂出了身世第6章 老道爷留下的遗物
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
“姐，我回来了。”
云昊走进院子就喊。
他知道出去一天时间，姐姐定然担心自己。
吱呀！
云微很快推门跑了出来：“小昊~”
看到弟弟回来，一颗悬着的心总算落地了。
但下一刻，她看到云昊穿着一身崭新的青色棉布衣服，背着一口大麻袋的时候一怔。
姐弟俩常年穿的是破旧不堪，甚至可以说衣不遮体的烂衣服，突然看到焕然一新的云昊，她还真有些愣神。
云昊微微见姐姐看自己的眼神，就知道怎么回事了，憨笑道：“姐，先进屋，我给你带好东西了。”
说话中云昊进了堂屋。
云微如梦初醒，连忙跟进去，帮着云昊将背着的大麻袋放下来。
她掂了掂居然很沉。
诧异道：“小昊你就这样一路背回来的？”
云昊嗯了一声，明白姐姐是在心疼自己，其实他真的没感觉到有多重。
虽然是近百斤的重量，从镇上到家四十多里路，可他仅仅是出了一身汗而已。
“你先歇歇，我去给你打水洗洗。”
云微连忙去打水。
云昊从怀里摸出宝瓶儿咕咚咕咚喝了一大口水，顿时清凉传遍全身，一身的乏气也解除了大半。
他对宝瓶的神奇，已经习惯。
“快洗洗擦把脸。”

云微端着水进来，粗布在木盆洗洗拧干，亲自上手给云昊擦脸，然后擦脖子和胸膛。
“姐，我自己来吧。”
云昊有些微微脸红，姐姐比他大一岁，今年十七岁，身体已经长成，正青春的年纪，他还是有些拘谨。
云微白了一眼道：“别动，你身上哪一个地方姐姐没见过？现在还不好意思了？”
说话中撩起了云昊的衣服，上手擦洗身上前后……
云昊没有再扭捏，虽然有些尴尬，但依旧任由姐姐摆弄自己。
感受着姐姐的粗糙的手在身上划来划去，云昊有些心疼她。
知道她手指都是去出挖野菜草根等等造成的，对自己个弟弟，她从来都照顾有加。
家里粮食不多的时候，她给他吃粮，她自己吃野菜吃草根，一切都是先紧着他这个弟弟。
“姐，人参卖了三吊钱，我给咱俩都买了两套衣服，还有米面等等，花掉了一半……”
云昊说话中从怀里取出剩下的一吊半铜钱交给姐姐。
将麻袋打开，取出了给姐姐买的衣服。
“这么多钱……？”
云微被惊到了。
三千文，哪怕云昊买东西花掉了一半，还有一千五百文，长这么大她都没见过。
云昊笑笑，拉着姐姐坐下，将今天在镇上卖人参的事讲述了一遍，也让姐姐收好钱，去试试衣服……
在云昊的催促下云微换上了新衣服，走出来的时候，云昊眼睛一亮。
云微有了几分羞涩，满眼都是开心。
自从父母去世后，她这是第二次穿新衣服。
云昊眼中的姐姐如今也是亭亭玉立，就是身形因为营养不良显得很消瘦，肤色也是蜡黄色，气色不好。

他知道姐姐是长期劳作没有打扮，如今是佛渡金，人靠衣，瞬间就成了美少女。
说姐姐是村里一枝花，也毫不为过。
content_en:
"Sister, I'm back."
Yunhao shouted as he walked into the yard.
He knew that his sister would be worried about him if he went out for a day.
Squeak!
Yun Wei quickly opened the door and ran out: "Xiao Hao~"
Seeing his brother coming back, his anxious heart finally fell to the ground.
But the next moment, she was startled when she saw Yun Hao wearing brand new blue cotton clothes and carrying a large sack on his back.
The siblings had been wearing shabby and shabby clothes all year round, which could even be said to be half-covered. She was really stunned when she suddenly saw the brand new Yun Hao.
Yun Hao saw the look in his sister's eyes and knew what was going on. He smiled and said, "Sister, come in first. I'll bring you something."
While talking, Yunhao entered the main room.
Yun Weiru woke up from her dream and quickly followed in, helping Yun Hao put down the large sack he was carrying.
She weighed it and it turned out to be very heavy.
Surprised: "Xiao Hao, you carried it all the way back like this?"
Yun Hao hummed, understanding that his sister was feeling sorry for him, but in fact, he really didn't feel how heavy it was.
Although it weighed nearly a hundred kilograms and traveled more than forty miles from town to home, he just broke out in a sweat.
"You have a rest first, and I'll get you some water to wash up."
Yun Wei hurriedly went to fetch water.
Yun Hao took out the treasure bottle from his arms and took a sip of water. Immediately, the coolness spread throughout his body, and most of his fatigue was relieved.
He was already accustomed to the magic of the Aquarius.
"Wash your face quickly."
Yunwei came in with water, washed the coarse cloth in the wooden basin and wrung it out, then wiped Yun Hao's face, then his neck and chest with his own hands.
"Sister, I'll do it myself."
Yun Hao blushed slightly. His sister was one year older than him. She was seventeen years old this year and her body had grown up. At the age of youth, he was still a little cautious.
Yun Wei rolled his eyes and said, "Don't move. Is there any part of you that my sister hasn't seen before? Are you embarrassed now?"
As he spoke, he lifted up Yun Hao's clothes and used his hands to scrub the front and back of his body...
Yunhao stopped squirming. Although he was a little embarrassed, he still allowed his sister to manipulate him.
Feeling his sister's rough hands scratching her body, Yun Hao felt a little sorry for her.
Knowing that her fingers were caused by digging for roots of wild vegetables, etc., she had always taken good care of her younger brother.
When there was not much food at home, she fed him food, and she ate wild vegetables and grass roots herself. Everything was done to keep her brother close to her first.
"Sister, ginseng sold for three ounces of money. I bought two sets of clothes for both of us, as well as rice, noodles, etc., and I spent half of it..."
As Yunhao spoke, he took out the remaining one and a half coins from his arms and handed them to his sister.
He opened the sack and took out the clothes he bought for his sister.
"So much money...?"
Yun Wei was shocked.
Three thousand Wen, even if Yunhao spent half of it on shopping, there was still fifteen hundred Wen, which she had never seen before when she was so old.
Yun Hao smiled, pulled his sister to sit down, and told him about selling ginseng in the town today. He also asked his sister to collect the money and go try on clothes...
At Yun Hao's urging, Yun Wei put on new clothes, and when she walked out, Yun Hao's eyes lit up.
Yun Wei felt a little shy, and her eyes were full of happiness.
This was the second time since her parents died that she was wearing new clothes.
The sister in Yun Hao's eyes is also slim now, but her figure is very thin due to malnutrition, her complexion is also sallow, and her complexion is not good.
He knew that his sister had been working for a long time without dressing up, but now that she was a Buddha, she was wearing clothes, and she became a beautiful girl in an instant.
It is no exaggeration to say that my sister is a flower in the village.
